description: This script implements a Redis consumer that processes messages from Redis keys with specific suffixes, transforms them into MISP events using a FeedGenerator, and handles errors by logging to Redis. It is designed for integrating Redis data into a MISP threat intelligence platform.

classes.name: RedisToMISPFeed
classes.description: A class that manages consuming Redis keys, processing data, and interfacing with the FeedGenerator to create MISP events based on Redis data.

methods.name: beautyful_sleep
methods.description: Displays a progress bar while sleeping for a specified duration, with additional message.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes Redis connection, sets up key names, and prepares the FeedGenerator.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Main loop that continuously consumes Redis keys, processes data, and handles sleep intervals.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Pops a JSON-encoded item from a Redis list key.

methods.name: perform_action
methods.description: Processes a data item based on the key suffix, adding sightings, attributes, or objects to the MISP event.

methods.name: update_last_action
methods.description: Updates the last action message and timestamp.

methods.name: format_last_action
methods.description: Formats the last action message with timestamp.

methods.name: save_error_to_redis
methods.description: Logs errors and problematic items into Redis.
